says: The windows' divider, a deep groove cut into the wood (wow-dev-tools design/character/engravings.md, look 5; theme ctl.cut): 8 px deep, its six rows centred. groove-dark is laid with the client's MOD (its dark rows mixed to white by their opacity, white elsewhere), groove-light with ADD (the lit lip times its opacity, black elsewhere). Each is one tile 64 px along, repeated along the cut (the rim and the lip vary along it); -upright, the same turned, the light from the left.
origin: Drawn by the design: wow-dev-tools `design/scripts/groove-rule.mjs deep <dark|light> <across|upright>` writes a page of the look`s pixels (`LOOKS.deep` in design/.vitepress/theme/rules.js); each page shot with `design/scripts/shot.mjs --width 400 --height 600` on `?bg=black` and `?bg=white`, then matted.
